name: Kaizu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kaizu city emblem in green and blue: green stylised leaves rising from a blue oval.
history: Municipal flag of Kaizu, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.

features.role: Kaizu city emblem — green stylised leaves rising from a blue oval
